column1: # The error findings that the OCSF toolkit (v0.9.0, against OCSF 1.9.0) reports on the example records of the action table
# today: action<TAB>code<TAB>attribute<TAB>how many. Each is a place where the stored record leaves out something OCSF's
# class requires (api and src_endpoint of API Activity, entity of Entity Management, user or service/dst_endpoint of
# Authentication) or has an attribute the class lacks (user of API Activity). ADR 0030's class mapping names where most of
# them belong (entity, resources[]); the emitters do not write them yet. The owner decided on 2026-11-07 to fix the records
# before the first release (ADR 0030, "The OCSF attributes a class requires"): each pull request of the series removes the
# lines it fixes, and the last one deletes this file and the tolerance for it. This file is not a place to keep findings.
# `go test ./tools/ocsf` fails on an error that is not listed, on more of one than the count, and on a listed one that is
# gone or fewer, so the list is exact. TestTheBaselineOnlyShrinks (run by `just ocsf-check` with main's copy of this file)
# fails in CI when a line is added or a count goes up against main, so the list can only shrink through a record fix.
